''' Related NPCs: ''' | Giants |} Kindly faction is required for all Thurgadin armor quests.
Set Totals ''(1 bracer)'': == Reward == {{Gear Set |Rune Crafter's Helm |Rune Crafter's Breastplate |Rune Crafter's Vambraces |Rune Crafter's Bracer |Rune Crafter's Gauntlets |Rune Crafter's Greaves |Rune Crafter's Boots }} == Checklist == Turn-ins to [[Terman Underbelly]] in [[Thurgadin]].{{CheckboxList}} *[[Rune Crafter's Helm]] :*[[Corroded Chain Coif]] :*3x [[Crushed Onyx Sapphire]] *[[Rune Crafter's Breastplate]] :*[[Corroded Chain Tunic]] :*3x [[Black Marble]] *[[Rune Crafter's Vambraces]] :*[[Corroded Chain Sleeves]] :*3x [[Jaundice Gem]] *[[Rune Crafter's Bracer]] :*[[Corroded Chain Bracer]] :*3x [[Crushed Opal]] *[[Rune Crafter's Gauntlets]] :*[[Corroded Chain Gauntlets]] :*3x [[Crushed Lava Ruby]] *[[Rune Crafter's Greaves]] :*[[Corroded Chain Leggings]] :*3x [[Chipped Onyx Sapphire]] *[[Rune Crafter's Boots]] :*[[Corroded Chain Boots]] :*3x [[Crushed Flame Emerald]] {{End}} == Walkthrough == You say, 'Hail, Terman Underbelly' : Terman Underbelly speaks in a rumbling tone. : Terman Underbelly says, 'Greetings. I only wish to speak to a shaman. Are you a shaman?' You say, 'I am a shaman.' : Terman Underbelly says 'I sense the strength of your mystical powers within you and they vibrate with power. You have learned much from your travels and I shall help you, by providing you with protection from harm and the elements, in the form of armor.' You say, 'What armor?' : Terman Underbelly says 'For you I shall make a coif, tunic, sleeves, a bracer, gauntlets, leggings, and boots. Each piece is a quest unto itself. To seek the components, you must search the lands for them and test the power of the spirit within.' '''Gems are dropped in various Velious zones while Corroded Chain Armor drops from the higher level giants in Kael Drakkel.''' '''After turn-in:''' Terman Underbelly smiles warmly as he hands you your reward. 'You have done well, _____.'
* Your faction standing with [[Coldain]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Dain Frostreaver IV]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Kromzek]] got worse. * Your faction standing with [[Kromrif]] got worse.
{{YouGainExperience}} == Helm == You say, 'How do you make a coif?' : Terman Underbelly says 'Those who are wise as we are know that protection of the head is most important. I may be able to forge you something most interesting if you were to bring me a [[Corroded Chain Coif]] and three pieces of [[Crushed Onyx Sapphire]].' == Tunic == You say, 'How do you make a tunic?' : Terman Underbelly says 'If you find a [[Corroded Chain Tunic]] and three pieces of [[Black Marble]] bring them to me and I shall attempt to create an enchanted tunic that will serve you well.' == Sleeves == You say, 'How do you make sleeves?' : Terman Underbelly says 'Three [[Jaundice Gem]]s and a set of [[Corroded Chain Sleeves]] might be an interesting combination. The powers of the gems may be harnessed to imbue the sleeves.' == Bracers == You say, 'How do you make a bracer?' : Terman Underbelly says 'Bracers are quite easy to imbue. Simply find three [[Crushed Opal]]s and a [[Corroded Chain Bracer]] and I will complete the ritual to enchant them.' == Gauntlets == You say, 'How do you make gauntlets?' : Terman Underbelly says 'Strong protection for one's hands is important. I may be able to craft you a set of powerful chain gauntlets if you find a set of [[Corroded Chain Gauntlets]] and three [[Crushed Lava Ruby|Crushed Lava Rubies]].' == Leggings == You say, 'How do you make leggings?' : Terman Underbelly says 'Leggings are a bit trickier to imbue. Three [[Chipped Onyx Sapphire]]s will allow me to channel the correct energies into a pair of [[Corroded Chain Leggings]] however those chipped onyx sapphires are somewhat rare. Return to me if you find such things in your journeys.' == Boots == You say, 'How do you make boots?' : Terman Underbelly says 'Simply bring me a set of three [[Crushed Flame Emerald]]s and a pair of [[Corroded Chain Boots]] and I will imbue them. I bid you good luck in finding such things.' [[Category:Shaman Quests]] [[Category:Quests]] [[Category:Thurgadin]] [[Category:Thurgadin Armor Quests]]
